## Scenarios

Rates are given to six decimal places throughout.

| # | Scenario | Steps | Rate | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Standard product | Open the app, select Standard, read the summary rate | 2.145000 | Pass |
| 2 | Promotional product | Open the app, select Promotional, read the summary rate | 1.980000 | Pass |
| 3 | Term change | Set the term to 24 months, read the summary rate | 2.310000 | Pass |
| 4 | Reopened case | Reopen the saved case from the overview, read the stored rate | 2.310000 | Pass |
